shared_elements: low-relief carving with raised forms against a flat ground
horizontal register/banding of repeated small units (a beaded row in A, rows of blocks in B)
justification: The only correspondence is generic: both surfaces carry raised carving organized in part into horizontal rows of repeated small units (a beaded/dotted border in A, stacked rectangular sign-blocks in B). Otherwise the content is quite different: A shows a rounded, naturalistically modelled figural scene with an apparent head/helmet, limbs and drapery folds in overlapping depth, while B shows only flat, rectilinear, schematic sign-like compartments in a grid with no figural or animal forms.
